label: b1: DDQN baseline at defaults, seed 4
notes: Seed-matched with b1a-baseline-seed1, which is running on the laptop. Every knob is a default and only SNEK_SEED varies, so the four arms serve both the phase-3 gate (any arm reaching 90% perfect) and phase 5's b47-class region comparison. Deliberately NOT raising SNEK_COLLECT_ENVS: the measured 1.9x from 16 lanes would confound the seed comparison against b1a, so it waits for a batch where all four arms can take it.
